description: This file defines the NonBufferedBody class, which implements the PSR-7 StreamInterface for an unbuffered, non-seekable, and non-readable HTTP message body. It primarily provides methods to write to the body and throw exceptions on unsupported operations.

classes.name: NonBufferedBody
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 StreamInterface representing an unbuffered, non-seekable, and write-only HTTP message body. It throws exceptions on operations that are not supported and allows writing to output directly.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns an empty string, as this body does not support reading content.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException because this body is not closable.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Returns null; detaching is a no-op for this stream.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns null, indicating size is unknown or not applicable.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns 0; position tracking is not supported.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Returns true, indicating end-of-stream is always reached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Returns false; the stream cannot be seeked.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException because seeking is not supported.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException because rewinding is not supported.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Returns true, indicating the stream supports writing.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Outputs the given string directly to the output buffer, cleaning any existing output buffers first, and returns the length of the string written.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Returns false; reading is not supported.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Throws RuntimeException because reading is not supported.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns empty string, as there are no contents to read.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns null; metadata is not supported or available.
